profile.name: 原始数据写盘组件
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在实验采集过程中异步将原始数据流写入磁盘文件，以尽量降低对 UDP 接收可靠性的影响。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for asynchronously writing raw data streams to disk files during experimental acquisition, helping minimize impact on UDP reception reliability.
